description: Saas-Fee is the car-free village on a plateau at about 1800 metres, and this frame is the parish church of Herz Jesu among wooden chalets and granaries. The Allalinhorn glacier balcony already published is a different viewpoint, and the high ice stays distant under cloud. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 12°C, with a strong wind, very dry air, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
